title: ChatHealthy ProviderMedicare
description: One document per provider x molecule in the providerMedicarePartDQuantityRollUps collection (EPIC-010-F-007). The provider is the core object; each document is one Part D molecule that provider prescribed, with the provider's brand rows collapsed and usage summed. _id is "<npi>:<molecule_id>". indications is the normalized-indication search key (filled by enrich from the NormalizedIndicationMap); drug_class and identity are the molecule's FDA facts, joined by molecule_id. Part B procedures and organizational CCN/size are out of this collection's scope.

prescriber_state.description: the provider's CMS prescriber state (one per provider)

nucc_codes.description: provider NUCC taxonomy codes from Provider_v_5; CMS Prscrbr_Type is not carried

molecule_id.description: proprietary molecule surrogate; the join key to the FDA file and the NormalizedIndicationMap

brands.description: distinct brand names collapsed into the pair

record_count.description: CMS Part D rows behind this provider x molecule; the conformance unit

totals.description: all-ages usage summed across the provider's brand rows (additive)

ge65.description: 65-and-over usage: the sum of visible rows plus a count of rows CMS suppressed (GE65 suppression is all-or-nothing)

benes.description: non-additive; carried only when a single unsuppressed row backs the pair, else null

indications.description: normalized indication ids from the NormalizedIndicationMap; the (indications, npi) search key

drug_class.description: SET of the molecule's FDA label classes

identity.description: rxcui / unii / substance_name unioned across the molecule's FDA labels
